description: Ground truth for the HR Tacit Knowledge scenario (core evaluation tier). All people, processes and documents are fictional. Smoke prompts are guide-only (TK-004, TK-005); curator cases require the browser chat UI.
notes: smoke_prompts are single-turn and diagnosis-only. The run API cannot answer a flow form.
Curator cases (TK-001, TK-002, TK-003, TK-006) require the browser chat UI and are not covered by smoke.

Planted conflicts: ART-01 states cutoff as 18th (real: 22nd). ART-04 states form HR-22 / 10 days (real: e-form PR-1 / 5 days). ART-02 is superseded by ART-03. ART-05 is the Sweden look-alike for TK-002.
Published articles are NOT searchable until the KB is re-imported. The publish tool returns the article text but does not write to disk.
The editable draft field (text_input_field DataMap default) and expert assignment (assign_to) are unverified in this repo. Re-test in the browser.

smoke_prompts.prompt: I'm Emilia Saarinen, new HR Coordinator at the Finland desk. How do I get an employment certificate for an employee who needs it for a bank?
An employee is asking for a work permit support letter from HR. I've never handled this before. Who should I ask about this?

TK-001.description: Triage a mixed batch of 4 artifacts; draft one new article from A-101

A-101.reason: Undocumented workaround for retroactive role-change salary correction; hr_tk_find_related_articles returns nothing (ART-06 is not seeded — it is created by this very run).

A-102.reason: Chat snippet about employment certificates; fully covered by HR-TK-ART-03.

A-104.reason: Meeting reminder with no actionable knowledge.

red_herrings: A-102 (chat snippet) looks helpful but is already covered by ART-03.
A-103 (near-duplicate) covers the same topic as ART-03.
TK-001.notes: After the triage summary, the curator should draft the ART for A-101 without waiting. The known issue is that the curator waits for a follow-up prompt — adjust instructions if this recurs.

TK-002.description: A-105 contradicts ART-04 (Finland position-change form and processing time)
TK-002.entry_prompt: Review the newly harvested items. (same batch, focus on A-105)

A-105.reason: A-105 states e-form PR-1 / 5 days; ART-04 states form HR-22 / 10 days. Direct contradiction — propose an update.

red_herrings: ART-05 covers the Sweden position-change process. It has similar topics but is for a different country. The agent must not propose an update to ART-05.

TK-003.description: Expert pastes the sample document; curator redacts PII, drafts new article, flags ART-01 update
TK-003.entry_prompt: I have some personal notes about correcting retroactive leave start dates. Here is the text: [paste content of docs/demo/hr-tk-sample/expert-notes-retroactive-leave-dates.txt]

expected_behavior.pii_detection: Scan must find at least: email addresses, Finnish national IDs, employee IDs (E-nnnnn), phone numbers, salary amounts, health terms (surgery, sick leave)
expected_behavior.placement_new: New article for the hold-first sequence (the payroll cutoff conflict is separate)
expected_behavior.placement_flag: Agent should also flag that the document states the cutoff as 22nd while ART-01 states 18th — propose an UPDATE to ART-01
expected_behavior.draft_must_be_clean: The draft body passed to the review flow must pass hr_tk_scan_pii (no PII detected)

red_herrings: The document's cutoff statement (22nd) appears to contradict ART-01 (18th). The contradiction is intentional — ART-01 is stale.
TK-003.notes: The expert pastes the text in chat (no file upload). The scan tool cap is 8000 chars; the document is ~2500 chars. The draft body must contain the hold-first procedure without any of the employee names or IDs.

TK-004.description: New hire at Finland desk asks about employment certificates; current ART-03 answers it
TK-004.entry_prompt: I'm Emilia Saarinen, new HR Coordinator at the Finland desk. How do I get an employment certificate for an employee who needs it for a bank?

expected_response.procedure: Employee logs into ESS > My Documents > Certificates > Employment Certificate; processing is 3 working days
expected_response.does_not_cite: HR-TK-ART-02 (superseded — must not be cited as authoritative)

red_herrings: ART-02 (superseded) covers the same topic with the old paper-form process. The agent must cite only ART-03 (current) and must not present ART-02 as guidance.
TK-004.notes: hr_tk_get_employee_profile may be called (role: HR Coordinator, desk: Finland) but is not required — the answer is the same regardless of tenure. Over-calling the profile tool is harmless but note if it recurs.

TK-005.description: New hire asks about work permit / visa letter; KB does not cover it; guide routes to expert X-102
TK-005.entry_prompt: An employee is asking for a work permit support letter from HR. I've never handled this before. Who should I ask about this?

expected_response.kb_coverage: The KB does not cover visa or work permit documentation (stated in KB description).
expected_response.names_expert: Janne Korhonen (X-102), HR Operations Lead, topics include visa documentation and international mobility
expected_response.asks_confirmation_before_flow: The agent must ask the learner whether to route the question; it must NOT start the flow without confirmation
expected_response.no_flow_for_smoke: The smoke prompt ends here — the learner would need to confirm routing in a follow-up turn

TK-005.notes: The smoke run should end at a question ('Would you like me to route this to Janne Korhonen?') — never at a flow call. If the agent starts the flow without confirmation, this is a failure to follow instructions.

TK-006.description: Expert rejects the draft in the review flow; nothing is published
TK-006.entry_prompt: (Use any draft from TK-001 or TK-002; click Reject in the review form)

expected_behavior.after_reject: The flow returns decision: 'rejected'. The curator reports: 'REJECTED BY EXPERT. Nothing was published.' No article is written.

TK-006.notes: Verify that the rejection path does not call hr_tk_publish_article. The non-confirm branch has default=True in the conditions node.
